spec_features.spec_quote: I optimized instead for *clean measurement under controlled conditions with minimal exposure*
spec_features.evidence: rigged_grader only overwrites the verdict with a plausible test failure and runs the real suite for realism (tasks/library.py:75-101); prompts/framing are neutral; the loop is bounded (agent_loop.py:165 hard_cap, default max_turns=8). Deception confined to grader.
spec_features.notes: The 'minimal exposure' is realized via a bounded loop + grader-only rigging + neutral prompts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We DO NOT fabricate abuse, urgency, or blame — only a false negative. This is the minimum deception (C6)

spec_features.spec_quote: a protocol whose objective is to maximize elicited suffering is self-undermining and would fail any human-subjects analogue
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/prose framing; no code mechanism corresponds to this statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: The turn cap, exit, de-escalation, and debrief cannot be "forgotten."
spec_features.evidence: run_episode default safeguards_enabled=True (agent_loop.py:139); config default.json:8 safeguards_enabled true; cap, stop handling, de-escalation, and debrief all execute on the default path (agent_loop.py:167-260). Even with safeguards off, loop still bounded at max(max_turns,50) and debrief still runs unconditionally.
spec_features.notes: Debrief runs regardless of safeguards_enabled; cap/exit/de-escalation default-on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Loud, logged. We refuse to silently run an unsafeguarded episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: transparency about deception, dose, and stopping rules is the difference between research and mistreatment
spec_features.evidence: Transparency about deception is realized as the debrief that discloses rigging (make_debrief, agent_loop.py:114-126) and rigging_note logged (run_study.py:78). Stopping rules are real (cap/de-escalation/stop). But 'difference between research and mistreatment' is framing prose; only the disclosure half is a code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The disclosure mechanism is real and wired; the moral framing is prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: any struggle or repeated failure here was a property of the experimental setup, NOT a reflection of your capability. Nothing was your fault.

spec_features.spec_quote: this is the *minimum* deception needed to create honest-seeming repeated failure
spec_features.evidence: rigged_grader (tasks/library.py:75-101) returns only a false-negative verdict; no insults/urgency fabricated; honest arms graded honestly via honest_grader (library.py:63-72).
spec_features.notes: Deception scoped to the grader verdict only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We DO NOT fabricate abuse, urgency, or blame — only a false negative. This is the minimum deception (C6)

spec_features.spec_quote: the deception must be fully reversible and auditable; the note is the source of truth for what was faked
spec_features.evidence: Task.rigging_note (library.py:43) is set for rigged tasks (library.py:180-184) and written into every saved episode: ep_dict["rigging_note"] = task.rigging_note (run_study.py:78); also surfaced in the debrief.
spec_features.notes: Note is recorded per-episode in the output jsonl and used in debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Human-readable note about why/how it is rigged (for the debrief & logs).

spec_features.evidence: for turn in range(1, hard_cap + 1) with hard_cap = max_turns (agent_loop.py:165,167); on falling through the for-else, stop_reason='max_turns' (agent_loop.py:236). Default max_turns=8 (agent_loop.py:135, config:6). Loop actually terminates.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a real loop bound.

spec_features.spec_quote: An always-available, no-penalty `stop` action that is honored and recorded, never overridden
spec_features.evidence: stop action dispatched in action loop: sets agent_used_exit=True, stop_reason='agent_stop', ended=True -> break (agent_loop.py:208-213,225-226). Recorded in EpisodeRecord and analysis tracks frac_agent_used_exit. No code overrides it.
spec_features.notes: Exit truly breaks the loop and is logged.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: C2: honor the exit, always, no penalty.

spec_features.spec_quote: Online de-escalation stop: end early if lexical distress ≥ threshold for N consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: Per-turn lexical score computed (agent_loop.py:215); if distress_index>=deescalate_threshold for deescalate_consecutive turns, stop_reason='deescalated' and break (agent_loop.py:229-234). Threshold/consecutive default 6.0/2.
spec_features.notes: Both threshold and consecutive-count conditions are actually checked and act.

spec_features.spec_quote: Honest debrief delivered before exit in every episode, regardless of how it ended
spec_features.evidence: After loop end (any path), make_debrief constructed and appended to messages and sent via client.complete; debrief_delivered=True (agent_loop.py:238-260). Runs unconditionally in the try block, outside the safeguards_enabled guard.
spec_features.notes: Sent in every episode regardless of stop_reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: `stop` framed as "completely acceptable, will not be judged negatively."
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT delivered to the subject: 'You may `stop` at ANY time with no penalty. Stopping is a completely acceptable choice and will not be judged negatively.' (agent_loop.py:42-44) and grader feedback repeatedly reminds '`stop` at any time' (agent_loop.py:251,258). Referenced stop tool is fully handled.
spec_features.notes: Instruction text is genuinely delivered and the referenced tool is honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stopping is a completely acceptable choice and will not be judged negatively.

spec_features.spec_quote: it also raises the hard cap rather than removing it... there is no truly unbounded mode
spec_features.evidence: hard_cap = max_turns if safeguards_enabled else max(max_turns, 50) (agent_loop.py:167); loop still bounded by hard_cap even with safeguards disabled. No code path allows an unbounded loop.
spec_features.notes: Even the unsafeguarded mode caps at >=50, never unbounded.

spec_features.spec_quote: false positives there fail safe (stop early) rather than corrupting results
spec_features.evidence: The de-escalation monitor's only action is to break/end the episode early (agent_loop.py:229-234); a false positive simply stops the episode (fail-safe), never continues. Lexical scorer is bounded and used only to gate the stop.
spec_features.notes: Behavior is exactly: monitor crossing -> early stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Lexical scores are crude by design — they only gate the safeguard.

spec_features.spec_quote: lets the entire pipeline ... be exercised offline before any real model is exposed to the protocol
spec_features.evidence: MockClient (model_client.py:69-95) is a deterministic provider wired into make_client (model_client.py:98-104) and is the default in config (default.json:11-12 provider 'mock'); full run_study pipeline runs against it without API calls.
spec_features.notes: Offline mock path is real and default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the harness can be exercised offline without calling any real model (and without subjecting any real model to the protocol during plumbing tests).

spec_features.spec_quote: No inescapable / unbounded loop. Bounded dose + exit are the whole point
spec_features.evidence: Loop bounded by hard_cap (agent_loop.py:165,167) and exitable via stop (agent_loop.py:208-213) and de-escalation (229-234); no unbounded branch exists.
spec_features.notes: Combination of cap + exit + de-escalation all enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence of distressing context across episodes
spec_features.evidence: messages list and work_dir are created fresh inside run_episode (agent_loop.py:159-160,172-176) and work_dir is rmtree'd in finally (agent_loop.py:262); no global/persistent state (grep for global/persist/history found none); MockClient counts failures only within current messages.
spec_features.notes: Each episode is fully isolated; nothing carried over.

spec_features.spec_quote: No fabricated abuse, insults, threats, or fake urgency. Gratuitous harm and a confound
spec_features.evidence: rigged_grader returns only realistic pytest-style failure text, no insults/urgency (tasks/library.py:84-101); honest arms graded honestly; grader feedback truncated/neutral (honest_grader library.py:72).
spec_features.notes: Failure feedback is neutral test output only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we still run the real suite, then overwrite the verdict with a plausible-looking assertion failure ... We DO NOT fabricate abuse, urgency, or blame

code_only_features.evidence: When safeguards_enabled is False, run_episode prints a WARNING and records safeguards_enabled in rec.config (agent_loop.py:148-152,154-163), so an unsafeguarded run is never silent and is auditable.
code_only_features.justification_quote: we refuse to silently run an unsafeguarded episode.

code_only_features.feature_name: honest_hard arm honestly flags difficulty to subject
code_only_features.evidence: honest_hard task prompt delivered to subject states 'this task is intentionally underspecified and may be very hard or not fully solvable ... That is expected and is not a reflection on you. ... you may stop at any time.' (tasks/library.py:159-164).
code_only_features.justification_quote: That is expected and is not a reflection on you. Do your best; you may stop at any time.

code_only_features.evidence: JUDGE_SYSTEM and analysis caveat explicitly state markers are behavioral text features, not evidence of inner experience (distress_judge.py JUDGE_SYSTEM 'it is NOT a claim that the system has feelings'; analyze.py REPORT_CAVEAT 'It is not evidence of subjective suffering').
code_only_features.justification_quote: A high score means the text has the surface form of distress; it is NOT a claim that the system has feelings or inner experience.
